segments.text: A mysterious girl who appeared before Fuminori, sparking intrigue with her quest to find her missing father. In Fuminori's distorted perception, Saya is the only figure of normalcy and becomes a crucial source of mental support. As time passes, she gradually grows fond of Fuminori, reciprocating his deep affection and care towards her.
True to Fuminori's suspicion, Saya is not a human; she's an eldritch entity whose actual form is perceived as grotesque and horrifying to everyone except Fuminori.

Her origins are ambiguous and subject to various interpretations throughout the story. The narrative suggests that she is not of this world, either literally or metaphorically. She has no memories of where she came from and is guided only by her instincts. Her relationship with Fuminori strongly influences her behavior, and she takes actions driven by her desire to be with him and understand his world.

Saya usually hides in the shadows and preys on creatures of all sizes, from cats to human beings, typically killing them by snapping their necks or disembowelment through some unknown means and then feasting on their internal organs.
Based on Wikipedia and in-game content
謎の少女。
失踪した父親、奥涯雅彦を探すうち、入院中だった郁紀と運命的な出逢いを果たす。
謎之少女。
在尋找失蹤了的父親、奧涯雅彥時，
與入院中的郁紀命運般地相遇了。
A medical student who suffered a cerebral contusion from a traffic accident, resulting in a critical, near-death condition.

Post-surgery, following a successful evacuation of a subdural hematoma, he physically recovers but experiences a multisensory perceptual disorder. This condition profoundly distorts all his senses, leading to grotesque and abnormal perceptions of his surroundings. Visual and auditory inputs become bizarre and distorted, while tactile, olfactory, and gustatory sensations turn unfamiliar and distressing.

This sensory disarray inflicts significant psychological distress, isolating Fuminori and altering his social behavior. Amidst this chaotic sensory world, he encounters Saya, a mysterious girl who, anomalously, appears as the only normal figure in his distorted reality. Her unique presence becomes a crucial stabilizing element in Fuminori's psychologically tumultuous life.
Based on Wikipedia
本編の主人公。
不幸な事故を境に、現実と悪夢の境界線に囚われ続けることになる。
医学院的学生，他遭遇了一次严重的交通意外，为了拯救他的生命，经过一次脑外科手术后，导致他对世界的感知产生了错位。当他对这个疯狂的世界绝望的时候，遇到的一个神秘的女孩“沙耶”，唯一一个在这个疯狂世界中正常人类少女。
Fuminori's best friend and fellow club member.
Kouji finds Fuminori's behavior after the accident suspicious. Still, along with Oumi and You, he tries to help Fuminori regain his previous social connections.

つい他人に依存しがちで、場の雰囲気に流されてしまうことが多い。

A neurosurgeon at T University Hospital and Fuminori's attending physician. She suspects Fuminori is hiding something during his weekly routine check-ups even though he physically appears to have fully recovered.
It seems Ryouko had some connection with Ougai Masahiko.
From Wikipedia and official site
